prompt_summary: Nine small-size-first MU Desk shell icon concepts across Module Dock, Utility Stack, and Modular Block directions

items.name: A1 Module Dock · Violet
items.description: A bold violet rounded-square body with three broad off-white modular tabs seated in one charcoal dock

items.name: A2 Module Dock · Charcoal
items.description: A charcoal rounded-square body with a thick violet U-shaped dock holding three broad off-white tabs

items.name: A3 Module Dock · Open
items.description: A freestanding thick violet U-shaped dock holding three large charcoal and off-white module slabs, no enclosing window

items.name: B1 Utility Stack · Front
items.description: Three chunky offset rounded cards forming one compact diagonal stack, violet front card and off-white rear cards

items.name: B2 Utility Stack · Fan
items.description: Three broad rounded utility cards fanned into one compact square silhouette, one violet and two charcoal/off-white

items.name: B3 Utility Stack · Inset
items.description: A compact stack of two filled rounded tiles with one large inset module notch, violet dominant mass

items.name: C1 Modular Block · Lock
items.description: Three thick interlocking rounded blocks forming one near-square emblem, violet dominant block

items.name: C2 Modular Block · Pinwheel
items.description: Three broad rounded blocks turning around one small negative-space center, compact pinwheel silhouette

items.name: C3 Modular Block · Knot
items.description: Three joined rounded slabs forming a single modular knot with one strong violet face
